name: SpanDelta
description: Read-only local MCP server for comparing OpenTelemetry trace cohorts across releases and inspecting bounded trace evidence. Queries a user-selected SQLite database; no model execution, outbound requests, or trace ingestion through MCP. External and off until enabled.
saferAlternatives: Use a dedicated local SQLite database with appropriate filesystem permissions. Service and operation names may contain sensitive information.
Prefer list_datasets and compare_releases for aggregate results. Use inspect_trace only when detailed span timelines are needed.
The reviewed direct-command identity requires an MCP client command whose executable basename is spandelta. A client configured to launch java directly will not match it.
Review unrecognized future tools; do not assume MCP readOnlyHint annotations establish security or grant permission.
